description_en: Queries the status of an asynchronous export task for inventory results
description_zh: 查询盘点结果异步导出任务状态
name: GetInventoryExportTaskStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asynchronous export task, which is returned by AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge or AsyncExportInventoryAsset
parameters.help_zh: 异步导出任务 ID（由 AsyncExportInventoryKnowledge / AsyncExportInventoryAsset 返回）
parameters.name: export_task_id

Data.description_en: The paginated results of table assets

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL for the XLSX file. This parameter is returned when the status is SUCCESS and is an OSS pre-signed URL
DownloadUrl.description_zh: XLSX 文件临时下载链接（status=SUCCESS 时返回，OSS 预签名 URL）
DownloadUrl.title_en: XLSX 文件临时下载链接（status=SUCCESS 时返回，OSS 预签名 URL）
DownloadUrl.title_zh: XLSX 文件临时下载链接（status=SUCCESS 时返回，OSS 预签名 URL）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The reason for the failure. This parameter is returned when the status is FAILED

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the download URL. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is returned when the status is SUCCESS
ExpireTime.description_zh: 下载链接过期时间（Unix 毫秒时间戳，status=SUCCESS 时返回）
ExpireTime.title_en: 下载链接过期时间（Unix 毫秒时间戳，status=SUCCESS 时返回）
ExpireTime.title_zh: 下载链接过期时间（Unix 毫秒时间戳，status=SUCCESS 时返回）

ExportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous export task

Status.description_en: The status of the task. Valid values: INIT, RUNNING, SUCCESS, and FAILED
Status.description_zh: 任务状态：INIT / RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILED
Status.title_en: 任务状态：INIT / RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILED
Status.title_zh: 任务状态：INIT / RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILED

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of exported records. This parameter is returned when the status is SUCCESS
TotalCount.description_zh: 导出记录总数（status=SUCCESS 时返回）
TotalCount.title_en: 导出记录总数（status=SUCCESS 时返回）
TotalCount.title_zh: 导出记录总数（status=SUCCESS 时返回）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
